emails.subject: Quick question on DevOps and cloud search workflow
emails.body:
Hi Team,

I am building Hirelix for technical recruiters and specialist search teams.

LinuxRecruit looked especially relevant because you work in DevOps, cloud, open source, platform, SRE, and AI-adjacent engineering roles where a recruiter needs real technical signal before sending someone forward.

Hirelix focuses on one narrow workflow: client JD in, evidence-backed technical shortlist out. Each candidate comes with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can personalize.

Would you be open to a quick look and blunt feedback on whether this would be useful for your technical recruiting workflow?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
